item.title: Allendale East Cave – Soggy Wombats
item.description:
Allendale East Cave

Introduction

Known as the hole in the middle of the road or just ‘the Dale’, Allendale East Cave is a very popular site among the CDAA Cave rated divers in the Mount Gambier region. As it presents itself as a non-complex cave to dive in, the Soggy Wombats Team has been training, developing skills and accumulating experience in this cave since 2019. Although geographically far from the most developed cave systems in the region, ‘the Dale’ has a small ‘tunnel’ at it’s deepest end that has been in most of Australian’s Cave Divers dreams to break into something big. There hasn’t been any breakthrough in this cave in the last 20 years or so, but with the advances in exploration techniques, we might be surprised with what the future will tell us.

Applying Cousteau’s Approach to Modern Cave Exploration

Jacques Cousteau’s success in popularizing oceanography can be attributed to several key factors:

  1. Television and Documentary Filmmaking: Cousteau’s groundbreaking documentary series The Undersea World of Jacques Cousteau introduced millions of viewers to the beauty and mystery of the ocean. By bringing underwater exploration into living rooms through the medium of TV, he captured the public’s imagination. His ability to communicate science in an accessible and captivating way, often combining stunning visuals with storytelling, made oceanography feel more relatable.

item.title: Article - Corra-Lynn
item.description: When I tell people I’ve just met that I’m a cave diver with claustrophobia, I always get a few confused looks followed by an inevitable round of questions along the lines of “Oh, so how do you stop the panic then?”. But when I mention my claustrophobia to people who know me and the kind of cave diving I do, the reaction is generally more like “You are very clearly broken, Josh - what is wrong with your brain?”.

item.title: Unveiling the Crazy Wombat Tunnel
item.description:
Note: This is an edited version of Article - The Crazy Wombat Tunnel reduced to <1100 words for publication in Scuba Diver Magazine

It all started with a simple question: “What the hell is that empty spot?” Will had just wrapped up dozens of dives in Pines Cave to collect photogrammetry data and was now in the painstaking process of turning tens of thousands of still images into a high-resolution 3D model using Agisoft Metashape. Our eventual goal? A game-changing map to support divers exploring one of Mount Gambier’s most renowned cave sites.
